title: Clinical AI Research Atlas
question: Within a search-defined corpus of clinical prediction and decision-support research, how do trustworthiness-related language, publication activity, and coauthorship patterns vary across 2016–2025?
query: ("clinical prediction" OR "clinical decision support") AND ("machine learning" OR "artificial intelligence") AND (calibration OR explainability OR uncertainty OR interpretability)
limitations: Search terms select trustworthiness language by design. Counts and theme shares do not estimate all clinical AI. OpenAlex type does not establish peer review.
